candidates.existing: Competitor search 'программа для частного детского сада Казахстан учет посещаемости лицензирование' found no licensing-prep product. It showed only the state Indigo voucher system (12 regions) and the model operating rules for preschools.
candidates.name: Licensing-readiness and compliance file for private kindergartens and children's mini-centres (licensing from 2027, unannounced inspections from Feb 2026)
candidates.trigger: Mandatory licensing of all kindergartens reported from 1 Jan 2027 (phased, readiness-based; Education Ministry). Requirements include buildings, staff qualifications, programmes, material base, sanitary and fire norms, anti-terror protection and conditions for special-needs children. Since 1 Feb 2026 a control procedure allows unannounced inspections of organisations serving children.
candidates.unchecked: Name and number of the law and licence rules; whether the licence is issued through eLicense; list of required documents; penalties; whether the date is final (sources vary between next year and 1 Jan 2027); number of mini-centres; existing kindergarten software such as electronic registers.

candidates.buyer: Sole-trader and small-firm road hauliers, and shippers using them
candidates.category: 18. Transport operators (small trucking and bus fleets)
candidates.existing: Competitor search found 1C waybill solutions (1cbit.kz '1С:Управление затратами на автотранспорт. Путевые листы') and Ministry of Transport guidance. It found no ESUTD connector for small carriers; ESUTD itself is the state system. Note the name clash: K06 'ESUTD' is the labour-contract system.
candidates.known_note: Different system from K06 (labour contracts); same ESUTD acronym.
candidates.name: Small-carrier pack for waybills and TTN in the ESUTD transport-document system (trucks over 3.5 t)
candidates.trigger: Obligation to issue TTN and waybills electronically in ESUTD for trucks over 3.5 t, planned from 1 Jun 2026. Order of 5 Jun 2025 No. 185 suspended parts of the rules until 1 Jun 2026; the source page also shows suspension to 1 Jan 2027 and to 1 Jun 2027. Fines come from Law No. 155-VIII of 10 Jan 2025 amending the Administrative Offences Code (amounts not seen).
candidates.unchecked: Final in-force date and whether the obligation is suspended; fine amounts; whether own-cargo carriage is covered; whether ESUTD has a free web form that removes the need for third-party software; 1C connector coverage.

coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: Nothing authoritative found on a special household-employer regime in Kazakhstan; only generic legal-advice pages and an anhor.uz note on Uzbek nannies. Employer-side contract registration is the ESUTD labour-contract duty already in K06 (rejected). Nothing new.

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: Not searched separately; covered by K04. Nothing new beyond K04.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: Pawnbrokers are K09 (rejected). Second-hand dealers not searched separately; no evidence either way.

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: Digital marking of jewellery announced by the trade ministry for 2026 (earlier 1 Jul 2024 date slipped; pilot since 2022); final order and date unconfirmed. Close to K08 (marking). No Kazakh rule found on licensing of scrap-gold buying. Candidate C4.

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: Only EPR/utilisation-fee news (2015-2024 materials, 196 recyclers). No dismantler licensing or parts-traceability rule found. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: Livestock ID rules (Law on Veterinary Medicine art. 25; Govt Resolution 2331) are served by the state TortTulik app, which gives owners free e-vet passports and sale/slaughter notices. Transport needs a vet certificate or vet spravka. Nothing new; livestock markets not searched separately.

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: Slaughter allowed only at meat plants and designated places; ministry plan for slaughter points in about 7,000 villages (year not shown in source); veterinary-sanitary expertise is licensed via eLicense (6 MRP, per a non-official source). Weak candidate C7.

coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: Law of 19 Jun 2026 No. 319-VIII, in force 20 Aug 2026, introduces a vet passport per apiary issued by state vet organisations. Candidate C3 (small, weak).

coverage.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
coverage.found: Vet accounting and reporting rules (order 1500011265; forms incl. 1-vet journal; amended by order of 4 May 2026 No. 169, effective 12 Jul 2026 - looks editorial). No Kazakh vet-drug marking system found (results were Russian). Candidate C8 (weak).

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: Not searched; K05 already covers the 2027 well permit rule.

coverage.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
coverage.found: Municipal solid waste collectors are chosen by tender and must be in a registry (Ecological Code art. 367); no rule found for sewage-truck or septic operators. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
coverage.found: Search returned only fragments and Russian documents: pressure vessels and lifts need periodic technical examination under Kazakh rules, but no new 2026 rule, deadline or register was confirmed. Unverified.

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: Budget used on other categories; no search run.

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: Found only the state registration service for pesticides (e-licensing, free). No Kazakh equivalent of a pesticide turnover or usage tracking system was found. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
coverage.found: Labour ministry draft rules (Nov 2024) for private employment agencies that place Kazakhstanis abroad: requirements, a registry of compliant agencies, and cooperation with labour mobility centres. Final status unknown. No rule found on inbound foreign-labour agency reporting. Candidate C9 (unverified).

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: Almaty launched the Orynai digital burial database in Feb 2026. The Spiritual Administration of Muslims is digitising cemeteries in regional centres, with district and village mosque cemeteries to follow. Government plans administrative liability for illegal sale of burial plots. Akims have been given record-keeping powers for grave plots. Candidate C5.

coverage.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
coverage.found: Only a proposal that mosques and churches publish income and expenses annually; no adopted rule found. Halal supervision not searched. Candidate C6 (weak).

coverage.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
coverage.found: Taxi carriers' notification form now includes vehicle make, plate and year; a draft aggregator permit regime was reported in Apr 2025. Trucks over 3.5 t: TTN and waybills in ESUTD (the transport-documents system, not the labour-contract one in K06) planned from 1 Jun 2026, but sources conflict, with suspension dates of 1 Jan 2027 and 1 Jun 2027 also shown. Candidates C2 and C10.

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: Currency-exchange rules (NBK resolution 49 of 2019) were amended by NBK resolution No. 78 of 30 Jun 2026, effective 20 Jul 2026; content not read. Online cash registers are a general duty under the new Tax Code and out of scope. Market traders not specifically searched. Candidate C11 (unverified).

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: Private kindergarten licensing is reported for 1 Jan 2027 (6,526 private of 11,909 preschool organisations). Since 1 Feb 2026 unannounced inspections apply to organisations serving children. Driving schools: MVD wants a permit regime; training records are digital since 2026. Tattoo studios, small food producers and hunting outfitters not searched. Candidates C1 and C12.

coverage.found: Fuel-station control meters (KPU) have been mandatory under the oil-products law since 2024, and OilTrack on Qoldau.kz is the state monitoring system; 125 of 279 oil depots were live in real time (Dec 2025). No dated AZS-specific connection deadline, no LPG rule and no small-AZS reporting form found. State-run system, so little room for a vendor. See candidate C10 (unverified). Sources: https://inbusiness.kz/ru/last/kogda-vse-neftebazy-kazahstana-dolzhny-ustanovit-pribory-ucheta ; https://prg.kz/m/amp/document/38528008/

coverage.category: 22. Grain, coffee, cocoa and other commodity traders, millers and warehouses
coverage.found: Search returned only older grain-receipt rules (Law on Grain, quantity-quality accounting rules, grain receipt forms), with no 2025-26 IS or reporting change found. Unverified: whether a current grain information system obliges small elevators and mills to file. See C11 (unverified).

coverage.category: 23. Co-operatives, credit unions and savings groups
coverage.found: About 3,284 agricultural co-operatives at end of 2022, a co-operation plan to 2029, and easing of requirements for co-operatives built on household plots (Feb 2026). No credit-union or co-operative reporting rule found; the regulator transfer (AFR to National Bank) is unverified. Nothing concrete beyond K03-style generic reporting. See C12 (unverified). Source: https://bizmedia.kz/2026-02-04-selskohozyajstvennaya-kooperacziya-pokazyvaet-rost-v-kazahstane/

coverage.category: 24. Private clinics, labs and other health providers that bill insurers or state schemes
coverage.found: Private clinics contract with FSMS under the GOBMP/OSMS purchase rules, and 1C already sells a medical-institution configuration (1C:Madimed) with FSMS and SUMT integration, so the billing and exchange layer is covered. No separate small-clinic periodic report found. See C5 (rejected for the plain billing layer). Sources: https://www.1cbit.kz/blog/integratsiya-1s-s-servisami-fsms-i-sumt-v-reshenii-1s-madimed/ ; https://kapital.kz/gosudarstvo/121371/v-fsms-nachali-priyem-zayavok-na-okazaniye-meduslug-v-2024-godu.html

coverage.category: 25. Pharmacies, medicine importers, and users of controlled chemicals or precursors
coverage.found: Pharmacies: all medicines are subject to Data Matrix marking since 1 Jul 2024 via the Tanba operator (accept goods on a smartphone), and 1C:Apteka for Kazakhstan already supports marking (see C4, rejected). Precursors: licence from MVD (20 MRP fee), quarterly 'Darmek' inspections of storage security, licence revocation cases; Kazakh-specific accounting and reporting forms not confirmed (search returned only Russian rules). See C9 (unverified). Sources: https://pro1c.kz/articles/uchet-v-apteke/vse-o-markirovke-v-konfiguratsii-1s-apteka-dlya-kazakhstana/ ; https://24.kz/ru/news/social/742775-kontrol-za-oborotom-prekursorov-usilen-v-kazakhstane

coverage.category: 26. Security, cleaning and manpower agencies, and the firms that hire their workers
coverage.found: Strong finding for security agencies: from May 2026 they report quarterly by email to the MVD police department (by the 25th), with 13 data blocks including weapons and special equipment. In addition, a law adopted in Dec 2025 requires notice to the licensing police within 5 working days of suspension, resumption or work outside the registered location, and surrender of weapons for storage when suspended. See C1. Cleaning and manpower agencies: not searched (budget).

coverage.category: 27. Construction, mining and quarry contractors and suppliers: site registers, accreditation, local-content reports
coverage.found: Local-content (in-country value) forms exist for oil, gas and uranium (Minenergo order 204 of 20 May 2024). For solid and common minerals, quarry operators file under order 374 of 2018 (licence-obligation and controlling-person reports); form 1.1-TPI covers solid minerals, and whether it covers common-minerals quarries is unconfirmed. Construction journals already in K02. See C13 (unverified). Sources: https://prg.kz/m/amp/document/36795778/ ; https://zakon.uchet.kz/rus/docs/V100006145_

coverage.category: 28. Notaries, land agents, real estate brokers and other professionals with periodic or anti-money-laundering reports
coverage.found: Realtors have been financial-monitoring subjects since late 2020 (register in AFM web-sfm cabinet, internal-control rules, customer due diligence, suspicious-transaction reports under AFM order 13 of 22 Feb 2022). Notaries: a law signed Sep 2025 extends their duty to proliferation financing, with an MoJ draft amending item 26 of the notary rules. The AFM list also includes accounting firms, legal consultants and jewellery operators. A draft law on realtor activity and a 50 million tenge real-estate transaction reporting threshold bill are pending (status unchecked). See C2. Sources: https://inbusiness.kz/ru/news/finansovyj-monitoring-rieltorov-novye-trebovaniya-i-nereshennye-voprosy ; https://inbusiness.kz/ru/news/notariusov-obyazhut-peredavat-finrazvedke-dopsvedeniya-o-kazahstancah

coverage.category: 29. Hotels, guest houses and short-term rentals: guest registers, tourism levies
coverage.found: Hosts must notify migration authorities of arriving foreigners within 3 working days (in person or via vmp.gov.kz with the owner's e-signature; fines 10 MRP small business; repeat breaches can bar inviting foreigners; per a 2019 amendment article, current status needs checking). Tourism levy for foreigners: up to 5% of stay value, set by local maslihats; payment rules amended by order of 31 Jul 2026 no. 146 effective 25 Aug 2026; some maslihats carve out hostels, guest houses and rented housing. See C3. Sources: https://informburo.kz/stati/registraciyu-inostrancev-v-kazahstane-otmenili-no-oteleram-dobavili-otvetstvennosti-razbiraem-popravki.html ; https://zakon.uchet.kz/kaz/history/V2300033110/25.08.2026

coverage.category: 30. Small exporters and importers facing traceability or certification rules: food, fish, timber, forest-risk commodities
coverage.found: Only market-access news found (fish and honey to Azerbaijan, beef quotas to 30 Jun 2026, EU registry entry for a honey firm); no Kazakh traceability or e-certificate duty for small exporters identified. Not verified whether a state e-certification system covers it. See C14 (unverified).

coverage.category: 31. (country-specific) Private security organisations: kuzet law, MVD reports and weapons
coverage.found: Same as category 26 finding. Law on security activity amended Dec 2025 (5-day notices, weapons surrender on suspension); about 800 security firms reportedly had unaccounted weapons per a deputy (inform.kz). Latest consolidated text of the law dated 12 Jul 2026. Candidate C1.

coverage.category: 32. (country-specific) Employer checks of personal medical (sanitary) books for decreed groups
coverage.found: Electronic medical books since 1 Jan 2025; results in E-Densaulyk/eGov mobile; employers can check validity free on hr.enbek.kz, covering 15 worker categories (catering, pharmacies, services, health). The free state tool kills a verification product. See C6 (rejected). Source: https://bizmedia.kz/2025-02-07-v-kazahstane-lichnye-mediczinskie-knizhki-dostupny-onlajn/

coverage.category: 33. (country-specific) Fire-safety audit for businesses
coverage.found: Audit rules (MVD order 240 of 2017, amended by MES order 295 of 29 Jul 2025; expert accreditation rules amended 26 Mar 2026) make audit a paid service by accredited experts, not a mandatory duty found for small business. Demand reportedly 60-65% small business, but nothing makes it recurring and mandatory. See C7 (weak). Source: https://zakon.uchet.kz/rus/docs/V1700015099

coverage.category: 34. (country-specific) Tax Code 2026: VAT registration threshold cut to 10,000 MRP
coverage.found: From 2026 the VAT registration threshold on the general regime is 10,000 MRP (about 43.25 million tenge at MRP 4,325), filing within 5 working days of exceeding it; a turnover without registration is fined 15% of turnover (KoAP art. 275 part 5). Special-regime payers are excluded. Newly registered small firms must start issuing ESF and filing VAT returns; this sits next to K01/K07 and general accounting, so generic. See C8 (weak). Sources: https://www.inbusiness.kz/ru/last/kto-budet-obyazan-vstavat-na-uchet-po-nds-v-2026-godu ; https://bizmedia.kz/2025-10-30-nds-kto-i-kogda-dolzhen-vstat-na-uchet/

coverage.category: 35. (country-specific) Extended producer responsibility (ROP) for importers and producers of tyres, packaging, vehicles
coverage.found: A ROP operator collects recycling fees and contracts tyre recycling, but results were old (2015-2022) or about Russia. No current Kazakh small-importer filing rule confirmed. See C15 (unverified).

coverage.category: 36. (country-specific) Arms-owner control shooting and weapon registration (households and security firms)
coverage.found: Owners must present rifled civil and service weapons for control shooting every 5 years and (Jan 2026 reports) new controls on weapon circulation; this overlaps security firms in C1. Household buyer group (private owners) not assessed. See C1 notes.

candidates.buyer: Farms, small production TOO, car washes, gas stations, hotels, small enterprises and consultants who hold a special water-use permit (own wells or surface intakes). Outsourced to environmental consultants.
candidates.existing: State NISVR (national water resources information system) in industrial operation since 8 Sep 2026; it already receives 2,200+ PUV reports and 1,300+ 2-TP reports, so a free state channel exists. Competitor search ('программа учет водопотребления ... водомеры', 'консалтинг ... первичный учет вод 2-ТП сопровождение') found no commercial software or electronic water-meter journal product, and no public consultant price lists, only the regulations and the state system.
candidates.name: Quarterly PUV-1 primary water accounting and annual 2-TP (vodkhoz) reporting kit for small permit holders
candidates.trigger: Rules of primary water accounting, Order 109-NK of 4 Jun 2025 (in force 5-10 Jun 2025): permit holders keep stitched, numbered meter-reading journals (readings at least every 10 days for intakes and discharges), a scheme of measurement points, verified meters in the state measurement register, and file form PUV-1 quarterly by the 10th of the month after quarter, to the basin inspection (paper or Excel). Plus annual 2-TP (vodkhoz) per Statistics Committee Order 27 of 15 May 2020, due 10 Jan (agriculture 1 Dec). From 2027 the permit also needs a 5-year water-loss plan. Fine for use without permit 100 MRP for small business (Admin Code art. 141).
candidates.unchecked: How reports are filed in NISVR (whether required or optional, and whether it has a bulk or API route); count of permit holders (number of small ones); whether NISVR gives free journals and auto-reminders that would kill the idea; consultant pricing; whether a quarterly reminder and journal tool beats paper plus Excel for the consultant who handles 20-100 clients. Related to K05 (same buyer group, but this is a recurring quarterly/annual duty, not the permit file).

candidates.buyer: Permit-holding farms and enterprises with well or intake meters; metering service shops
candidates.existing: Not searched specifically; no vendor seen.
candidates.name: Water meter verification (poverka) and register tracker for water-permit holders
candidates.trigger: Permit rules and Order 109-NK require meters to be in the state register of measurement-uniformity instruments and verified under the Law on Ensuring Uniformity of Measurements; meter failure triggers estimate by average of last 10 days.
candidates.unchecked: Verification interval for water meters, who verifies (regional metrology centres), whether this is better folded into the PUV-1 kit. Likely a feature, not a stand-alone product.

candidates.buyer: Rural akimat-linked TOO and municipal water enterprises, small private water supply operators, water co-ops, pipeline operators in villages (74 group pipelines plus many local wells and standpipes).
candidates.existing: Not searched; no competitor search run because the score is below 3 on the evidence available.
candidates.name: Small rural water-supply operator compliance pack (production control programme, lab schedule, sanitary protection zones, DKREM tariff file)
candidates.trigger: MoH Order 26 of 20 Feb 2023 (amended 5 May 2025): production control of water quality, sanitary-epidemiological conclusion and sanitary protection zones; tariff and tariff estimate with DKREM for regulated water supply; water-use permit and PUV-1/2-TP reports for the operator's own intake.
candidates.unchecked: Actual small-operator count and legal form; production control frequency and who files what with the sanitary service; whether municipal buyers pay (budget-funded, likely tenders); whether it falls under the same buyer group as the quarterly PUV-1 candidate; competition from 1C and municipal ERP. Buyer accessibility likely poor (public entities).

candidates.buyer: Permit applicants and renewals from 1 Jan 2027 that abstract from surface sources
candidates.existing: Not checked.
candidates.known_note: Part of the 2027 permit rule already covered by K05.
candidates.name: Water-loss reduction / BAT plan preparation for 2027 permit renewals
candidates.trigger: From 1 Jan 2027 applicants must submit a plan to reduce water losses and apply best available technologies, covering at least five years, unless they take no surface water or have fully implemented BAT.
candidates.unchecked: None; not re-checked per the contract.

candidates.buyer: Small water-truck operators and bottling points serving the roughly 5% of rural households that rely on delivered water
candidates.existing: Not checked.
candidates.name: Delivered water (water-hauling trucks) and bottled-water small suppliers
candidates.trigger: Sanitary rules on drinking water (MoH Order 26 of 2023) and permit/notification regime under the Law on Permits and Notifications; no specific rule for haulers was found.
candidates.unchecked: Whether hauling needs any permit or notification, whether there are recurring registers (lab protocols, tank sanitising log), operator count.

candidates.buyer: Small drilling contractors and hydrogeologists
candidates.existing: None seen.
candidates.name: Drilling contractors: well passport, abandonment and basin-inspection agreement tracker
candidates.trigger: Drilling needs prior agreement with the basin inspection (offence otherwise); search-and-appraisal groundwater projects need a licence; no separate driller licence or recurring register confirmed.
candidates.unchecked: Whether any driller register, well passport or abandonment (tamponage) duty exists in current rules; number of drillers; licence status. No recurring duty found, so likely not a candidate.

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: Permit rules (Water Code art. 45, effective detail from inbusiness.kz): special water-use permit needed for groundwater use except first-aquifer shaft/tube wells not used for centralized supply, abstraction up to 5 m3/day for non-centralized supply, and remote-pasture livestock watering. From 1 Jan 2027 applicants must submit a 5-year water-loss reduction/BAT plan (K05 territory). Permit holders must have verified meters in the state measurement register, production control, passports for intakes; groundwater above 50 m3/day needs approved reserves, above 1,000 m3/day monitoring programme. Fine for no permit: 50 MRP individuals, 100 MRP officials/small business (Admin Code art. 141). Recurring duties found beyond K05: quarterly PUV-1 primary water accounting report (Order 109-NK of 4 Jun 2025, in force; due by the 10th of the month after the quarter, to basin inspection, paper or Excel; journals of meter readings every 10 days) and annual 2-TP (vodkhoz) report (Order 27 of 15 May 2020; due 10 Jan, agriculture 1 Dec). State NISVR system went into industrial operation 8 Sep 2026 and already accepts PUV and 2-TP reports (2,200+ and 1,300+ received), and permit application via NISVR is a pilot. No separate licence for drilling contractors found; geological-study licence applies to exploration of groundwater (search-and-appraisal project). Drilling 200 m+ for water supply triggers environmental procedure (unconfirmed). Drilling without basin inspection agreement is an offence. No driller-specific recurring register found; drilling-contractor angle not confirmed.

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: Sanitary rules on drinking-water sources and supply (MoH Order 26 of 20 Feb 2023, amended 5 May 2025) cover production control of water quality, sanitary-epidemiological conclusion and sanitary protection zones. 74 group water pipelines and 5% of rural households on delivered water; operators are often akimat-linked TOO or municipal enterprises with tariffs set by the DKREM (natural monopoly regulator). No specific small-operator reporting forms or lab-schedule rules were confirmed in the 3 searches; rural water co-op/water-user association duties were not found (1996 group-pipeline rules repealed in 2005). Delivered-water / water-hauling and bottled-water niche: no specific rule found. Candidate listed as unverified.
